clusters.headline: United Nations COP31 Climate Summit Commences In Antalya Turkey
aiSummaryBullets: The UN COP31 climate conference began in Antalya, Turkey, with delegates gathering to address global climate goals amidst recent extreme weather.
United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for renewed urgency in climate action as negotiations over international funding commence.

clusters.headline: United Nations COP31 Climate Change Summit Begins In Antalya Turkey
aiSummaryBullets: The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) is scheduled to begin on November 9 in Antalya.
Delegates will discuss implementing concrete measures to address the global climate crisis.
